endermagnolia-v0.0.4.description:
Pre-release of the **Archipelago** world for **Ender Magnolia**

## Update
 - Logic for Levy quests return

## Requirements
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
- [Ender Magnolia Randomizer](https://github.com/Trexounay/EnderMagnolia.Randomizer/releases) Get the corresponding version

## Current Features
- 340 checks
- 1 Goal: **Ending A**
- Starting Skill option

## Planned Features
- Currency support
- Additional options:
  - Ending B goal
  - Minimum/maximum chapter settings

## Notes
This is an early pre-release and has not been extensively tested. Expect bugs and missing features, and please report any issues or feedback.
endermagnolia-v0.0.4.title: Ender Magnolia World v0.0.4
